description: This file defines an API client class for interacting with a backend server, providing functions for user registration, login, and project listing, including handling authentication tokens via shared preferences.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A simple API client class for interacting with the backend, handling registration, login, and project listing.

methods.name: ApiClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the API client with optional custom HTTP client and base URL.

methods.name: _getToken
methods.description: Retrieves stored authentication token from shared preferences.

methods.name: _headers
methods.description: Prepares HTTP headers including authorization if available.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration by sending email, name, and password to backend.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login, saves received access token for future requests.

methods.name: listProjects
methods.description: Fetches list of projects from the backend.
